name: workspace-search
description: Workspace text search, lightweight semantic ranking, and result re-ranking for naitv-mcp agents.
author: madicen

entries.name: semantic_search
entries.body: Score files under root_path by token overlap with query (stdlib; no network/embeddings). Returns path + score.

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute path to the project root","required":true},{"name":"query","description":"Search query","required":true},{"name":"limit","description":"Max results (default 10)","required":false},{"name":"depth","description":"Max directory walk depth (default 3)","required":false}]

entries.name: text_search
entries.body: Regex search over text files under root_path; optional glob filter. Returns path, line, text.

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute path to the project root","required":true},{"name":"pattern","description":"Regex pattern","required":true},{"name":"glob","description":"Optional filename glob","required":false},{"name":"depth","description":"Max directory walk depth (default 3)","required":false}]

entries.name: rank_results
entries.body: Re-rank candidate paths against a query using token overlap.
